tools.name: sw_get
tools.description: Gets one Star Wars entity by numeric record id and returns it as a JSON object. Take the id from the end of an entity's url field (from sw_search, sw_list or a relation URL). Ids are record ids, not episode numbers: FILMS id 1 is A New Hope (Episode IV). An unknown id returns a tool error, e.g. 'No

tools.name: sw_list
tools.description: Lists every entity of one Star Wars resource type as a JSON array (Episodes I-VI data). Responses are large (all 82 PEOPLE, about 38 KB); to find a single entity, prefer sw_search, then sw_get.

tools.name: sw_random
tools.description: Returns one random Star Wars entity of the given resource type as a JSON object. Each call can return a different entity, so it is not idempotent. Useful for demos and quizzes; to fetch a specific entity use sw_search or sw_get.

tools.name: sw_search
tools.description: Start here. Finds Star Wars entities by name (title for FILMS) with a case-insensitive substring match: 'sky' finds Luke, Anakin and Shmi Skywalker. Returns a JSON array of full entities; an empty array [] means no match. The id to pass to sw_get is the last segment of each entity's url field. Data

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sw_get" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
